primary_endpoint: Percentage achieving ≥1-stage fibrosis improvement without worsening NASH at Week 72.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 72, 13.7% with SEMA + CILO/FIR FDC versus 8.3% with matched placebo; p=0.2289.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 17/124 with SEMA + CILO/FIR FDC; 13/122 with SEMA + PTM CILO/FIR; 18/123 with PTM SEMA + CILO/FIR FDC; and 11/84 with both PTM treatments. Deaths: 0, 1, 1, and 0, respectively.
